findings.evidence: grep: `Basic.lean:64: def prefixProj (α : Type*) (n : ℕ) (x : ℕ → α) : Fin n → α := fun i => x i.val`; `Basic.lean:164: theorem measurable_prefixProj (n : ℕ) : Measurable (prefixProj α n)`; `ContractableLaw.lean:88: ρ.map (prefixProj α n)`.
findings.fix: State the right-hand side as `∫⁻ x in A, g (prefixProj α m x) ∂ρ` and take `hf := hg.comp (measurable_prefixProj m)`; this matches the sibling `ContractableLaw.map_prefixProj_of_strictMono` (`PathSpace/ContractableLaw.lean:85-88`), which already pairs the raw block selection `fun i : Fin n => x (k i)` with `prefixProj α n`.
findings.issue: `hf := hg.comp (measurable_pi_lambda _ fun i => measurable_pi_apply _)` re-proves `Measurable fun x : ℕ → α => fun i : Fin m => x i.val`, which is exactly `measurable_prefixProj m` (`TauCeti/Probability/Exchangeability/Basic.lean:164`, for `prefixProj α m x = fun i => x i.val`, `Basic.lean:64`). The statement (line 73) likewise spells `fun i : Fin m => x (i : ℕ)` raw rather than the located combinator `prefixProj α m x`, so the new lemma does not compose with the existing `prefixProj`-phrased API.

summary: The two new theorems are genuinely new (no existing declaration states the invariant-event transport or the Birkhoff/prefix bridge), and the transport proof properly composes ContractableLaw.measurePreserving_reindex with Mathlib's MeasurePreserving.setLIntegral_comp_preimage. One spot re-derives an existing lemma: the prefix projection and its measurability are open-coded instead of using prefixProj / measurable_prefixProj.
